**Technico Pty Limited's turnover (FY25):**

Technico Pty Limited, Australia registered a turnover of Australian Dollars (A$) 2.86 million (previous year A$ 1.69 million) and a Net Profit of A$ 1.51 million (previous year A$ 0.81 million).

**Converted to Indian Rupees at today's exchange rate:**

Using the current mid-market AUD/INR rate of roughly ₹67.2 per Australian dollar (as of late September 2026), A$2.86 million works out to approximately **₹192.2 million**, or about **₹19.2 crore**.

*Note:* This conversion uses today's live exchange rate for reference. In its own accounts, ITC actually reports Technico's turnover in rupee terms using the exchange rate prevailing on the last day of the financial year (31 March 2025), which was ₹53.81 per AUD — giving a turnover of roughly ₹153.9 million (₹15.39 crore) at that rate. The two figures differ because the rupee has depreciated against the Australian dollar since March 2025.
